title: Haneda shirasu recall: pufferfish contamination, only one pack recovered
summary: May Class I food recall sa 食品館あおば本羽田店: dalawang '甘口しらす干' products sold August 22-28 may possible pufferfish contamination. Sa official filing, 441 packs/units were sold and only 1 had been recovered when the recall status was filed, so worth checking immediately if you shopped there.
why_it_matters: Pufferfish contamination can cause serious poisoning. Narrow ang affected store, pero very high ang consequence if an affected pack is still at home.

claims.text: The recall covers 甘口しらす干 products sold at 食品館あおば本羽田店 from August 22 through August 28, 2026, with best-before dates from August 27 through September 2.
claims.basis: MHLW recall filing and Consumer Affairs Agency recall listing

claims.text: The official filing states that 227 fixed 150 g packs and 214 variable-weight packs were sold, while the recorded recovered quantity was 1 at the time of filing.
The filing classifies the health risk as CLASS I because accidental consumption of pufferfish can cause pufferfish poisoning; no health damage had been reported at filing time.
Because the recorded recovery count was very low relative to sales, affected product may still remain in households even though the best-before window is ending.
claims.basis: Comparison of official sales and recovery figures

content.key_message: If you bought shirasu at 食品館あおば本羽田店 on August 22-28, check the pack now and do not eat a recalled product.
content.who_is_affected: Customers who bought 甘口しらす干 at 食品館あおば本羽田店 in Ota-ku, Tokyo, from August 22-28, 2026.
content.when: Recall started August 28; MHLW filing was published August 31 and the CAA recall listing surfaced September 2.
content.financial_impact: Refund is available at the selling store. No defensible household yen saving is stated because purchase prices vary and the main issue is safety, not money.
content.risk_if_ignored: Potential pufferfish poisoning. The official filing assigns CLASS I, its highest-risk recall class used for hazards that can cause serious health consequences.
content.deadline: No formal refund deadline is stated in the official filing; act immediately if you have an affected pack.
content.effort: Check the product name, JAN and best-before date; if matched, do not eat it and return it to the store for a refund. Official inquiry number: 03-6423-2518, 10:00-17:30.
content.potential_benefit: Avoids a low-frequency but potentially severe food-poisoning hazard and recovers the purchase price through the stated refund process.
content.downside: Very narrow scope: this is not a nationwide shirasu warning. It applies to the specified products sold at the specified Haneda store.
content.what_would_change_mind: A completed recall with substantially higher recovery, or an official finding that the contamination did not affect the listed products, would reduce the urgency.
content.usefulness: High for affected shoppers; low for everyone else.
content.novelty: Newly registered national recall information with a high official hazard classification.

reading_levels.30_sec: WHAT HAPPENED: A Haneda supermarket shirasu recall was filed after pufferfish contamination; 441 units were sold and the filing recorded only 1 recovered. WHY IT MATTERS: MHLW classifies the hazard as CLASS I. WHAT TO DO: If you bought 甘口しらす干 at 食品館あおば本羽田店 on Aug 22-28, don't eat a matching pack; return it for refund. BOTTOM LINE: Narrow recall, serious consequence for the small group affected.
reading_levels.2_min: FACT: The affected products are 甘口しらす干, including 150 g and variable-weight packs, sold at 食品館あおば本羽田店 from Aug 22-28. Best-before dates run Aug 27-Sep 2. JANs listed by MHLW are 2027205205809 and 2027205203300. FACT: 227 fixed packs plus 214 variable-weight packs were sold; the filing recorded 1 recovered. FACT: No health injury had been reported, but MHLW rates the hazard CLASS I because pufferfish ingestion can cause poisoning. ACTION: Do not eat a matching product; return it to the selling store for refund. This is a store-specific recall, not a general warning about shirasu in Japan.

content.bottom_line: Narrow audience, but DO NOW if affected: check, don't eat, and return the recalled shirasu.
content.confidence_reason: Two government sources agree on the product and contamination; detailed quantities and risk classification come from the MHLW filing.
